capabilities: capture thoughts into an inbox via command, ribbon, or external tools
process inbox items into projects, actions, reference, or someday/maybe
organize life areas into spheres with hierarchical projects
curate a focus list of next actions and track waiting-for items
expose a focus API and JSONL focus file for other plugins
extras: Author discloses the codebase is now AI-written. Beta builds are distributed via BRAT. Documentation lives on separate pages (GTD guide, templates, capture methods). AI cover-image generation is optional and off by default; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for Getting Things Done capture, inbox processing, and next-action focus, so open loops stay in your head.
